view.summary: A one-button rhythm game: tap on the beat to dodge, shoot and decorate desserts. Clear stages for stamps that level up talents, then take on Hard stages with score-boosting mods.

overview.title: How to play
items: Tap anywhere on the screen at the correct timing. (When playing on PC, use the spacebar.)
40 life (4 misses); each miss costs 10. Every 10 combo restores 5. At 0 the stage fails.
Perfect 350, Great 250, Good 150, Miss 0 on the first stage; some stages pay less (see Timing windows)
Each stage has three star conditions (see Stages).
Clearing stages on Normal after the specified date will unlock Hard Mode.
Limited Dessert Stamps are awarded each time you clear a stage on Normal for the first time. Coffee Stamps are awarded each time you clear a stage.
Your total score from either Normal Mode stages or Hard Mode stages will be recorded, whichever is higher.

overview.title: Hard Mode mods
overview.note: Mods can be switched on for Hard stages; each adds its bonus to the points you score.
rows: Increases the level of accuracy required.
Doubles the amount of life lost.
Ends the game if you miss.
Applies a blur effect to the screen.
